verdict.rationale: Jira's first-party pages name Slack explicitly as a tool you can connect to track progress and drive automation (jira-docs-2, jira-intdir-1). They also show native dev-tool links such as Bitbucket and development status shown inside Jira (jira-docs-17, jira-docs-21), plus a marketplace of 3000+ integrations (jira-docs-6, jira-docs-20). However, GitHub and Google Drive are never named, and marketplace apps are not clearly 'native.' Missing for 10: explicit native GitHub integration, explicit Google Drive integration, documentation of setup depth, independent or hands-on corroboration.
